posts.title: Interac makes e-transfers worse
posts.description: In early September I got an email from my credit union: Effective October 2026, Interac will be discontinuing its future-dated and recurring e-Transfer payment options. While we explored ways to maintain these features, they will no longer be available in online banking or the mobile app due to Interac’s decision to discontinue the service. What’s Changing?
